patterns.title: .NET runtime prerequisite is not installed
patterns.summary: The installer checked for a required .NET runtime and did not find it, so it stopped before changing anything: {detail}

remediation.detail: Install the exact runtime family and architecture named in the log (for example .NET Desktop Runtime x64). Packaging it as an Intune Win32 app (or a Patch My PC app) and adding it as a dependency makes the order automatic.
The check is usually 'greater than' a specific patch version. Deploy the latest servicing release of that major version, not just any one.
Desktop Runtime must be listed, not only the base .NET runtime.
Once the runtime is detected, re-sync the device so the app retries.

verification: `dotnet --list-runtimes` lists Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App at or above the required version.
The app installs with exit code 0 and its detection rule passes.

patterns.title: Visual C++ runtime is missing
regex: The code execution cannot proceed because (?:VCRUNTIME|MSVCP)
Microsoft Visual C\+\+ (?:20\d\d|Redistributable)[^\r\n]{0,80}(?:required|not installed|needs to be installed)
patterns.summary: A Visual C++ runtime library the application needs is not installed.

remediation.detail: Install the x64 (and x86 if the app is 32-bit) Visual C++ v14 Redistributable before the app, as a dependency.

patterns.title: A prerequisite check failed
patterns.summary: The installer reported that a prerequisite was not met.

remediation.action: Read the message around this line
remediation.detail: It normally names the missing item.

patterns.title: Operating system or platform not supported
regex: This installation package is not supported by this processor type
patterns.summary: The installer says this Windows version or CPU platform is not supported.

remediation.detail: Compare the device's OS build and architecture against the vendor's requirements.

remediation.action: Use the right requirement rule in Intune
remediation.detail: Set minimum OS and architecture so the app only targets supported devices.

patterns.title: Wrong architecture or damaged executable
regex: is not a valid Win32 application
patterns.summary: Windows could not run the installer binary: it is the wrong architecture (for example ARM64 vs x64) or the file is damaged.

remediation.detail: Match the installer to the device (x64, x86, ARM64).
Verify the hash of the binary against the vendor.

patterns.title: A restart is pending
patterns.summary: A previous change left the device waiting for a restart, which can block or break the next install.
